settings.heading: Contact Us
settings.body:
For order questions, shipping issues, product support, account questions, refunds, or damaged/incorrect/missing items, contact us at [Support Email].

For faster help, include your order number, email used at checkout, product name, clear description of the issue, photos or videos if the item is damaged/defective/incorrect, and tracking number if available.

Estimated response time: [Insert Response Time]. Response times may be longer during weekends, holidays, launches, or high support volume.

Do not send products to any address. We are starting with a no-return model and do not accept buyer-remorse returns or exchanges. We do not publish or use a personal home address for returns. If an item is damaged, defective, wrong, missing, unshipped, or materially different from the listing, contact support so we can review the issue and offer an appropriate resolution where required or approved.
